releases.title: More reliable SLD to SAP checks

items.text: This window: after an update, Structure Lab now shows what changed in the new version.
SLD to SAP reports more problems together before conversion: invalid Index values, negative load values, frames with zero length, and point names that differ only in letter case.
The EQ.Z coefficient now starts at 1.
Loads on frames drawn in the reverse direction are now matched correctly.
